reconnaissance.instructions: Programmatic: run tests, read source files, identify failing tests. No LLM needed — the plugin handles this automatically.

planning.instructions: You have the test results and source files from reconnaissance. Analyze the failing test(s), identify the bug, and form a plan. Do NOT edit files yet. Read additional files if needed. When you know what to fix, call statewright_transition with event READY. Use the provided tool functions directly — do NOT emit raw XML tool tags.

implementing.instructions: Fix ONLY the bug. Use edit or patch_file. Change the fewest lines possible. Do not modify test files. When done, transition DONE.

testing.instructions: Run the test suite to verify your fix. Use pytest (or the appropriate test runner). If tests pass, transition PASS. If tests fail, transition TESTS_FAIL to go back and fix.
